snippet.title: My Little Cafe Nightmare | Indieshowcase - Official Anouncement Trailer
snippet.description:
Take over the old run down cafe of a former shrunken head owner without a taste for good coffee inside a nightmarish dimension!

Your monstrous customers strive for just deadly good hot drinks, a vibrant and peaceful environment while you run the shop and keep out hostile anomalies.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3726250/My_Little_Cafe_Nightmare/

#indiegame #simulator #horrorgaming #coffee
